ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   C. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.

   D. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.

   D. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   D. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   D. Say Saum has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   D. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.

15. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Corruption and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Battle of Badr and Uhud 04 7.2 Treaty of Hudaybiya 03 7.3 Conquest of Makkah 07  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
